Each git blob SHA-1 (of "blob <size>\0" + bytes) equals the one GitHub's contents API lists for that path.
Unchanged; the rest of the repository (demo MIDIs, support files, README.html/.pdf, percussion map) was not taken.
The SF2's own INFO says INAM "GeneralUser GS 2.0.3 BETA", ICRD "Tuesday 15 October 2024, 09:47:28", ISFT "Polyphone":
the author's file as released, the name tag included.
Licence: documentation/LICENSE.txt (GeneralUser GS License v2.0; also embedded as the bank's ICMT). Use and
modification are free; a website should host its own copy, never link to the author's downloads.
GeneralUser-GS.sf2 is the lossless original: the reference of the 8.4 MB SF3 that Sumika ships
(vendor/generaluser-gs-2.0.3-sf3, docs/research/midi.md), and kept for a later "better sound" choice. It is not in the
repository (32 MB): to compare, put the author's file of the commit above into this folder (its size and SHA-256: the
table above, and engines/midi/pins.json "reference"). Never published.
Pinned by engines/midi/pins.json (a tree pin over this folder with the SF2 in place, this file included: the method
of kawari-wasm.md §1).
